title: The most joyful Shakespeare production I’ve ever seen is coming to Br...
transcript: I genuinely cannot wait to feel this amount of joy again because Jamie Lloyd's much ado about nothing is coming to Broadway this fall. Now, I saw this production in London in 2025, and it was one of my favorite theater experiences of the year. Jamie Lloyd is known for directing revivals that are stark black and white, intensely dramatic. Much ado about nothing throws all of that out the window. This show is a bright pink, wildly whimsical shakespearean disco. It has an incredibly charismatic cast LED by the ridiculously charming Tom Hiddleston and Haley Atwell as Benedict and Beatrice. The banter flies, the physical comedy is top notch, the romance at the heart of the story feels surprisingly tender and well earned. It truly is one of my favourite Shakespeare productions I've ever seen, and I am so excited that it is coming to New York. Much ado about nothing begins previews October 31st at the Winter Garden Theatre and is running for just 10 weeks until January 10th. I promise you're gonna Wanna experience this one for yourself.
classificationReason: Anticipation/announcement of Jamie Lloyd's Much Ado About Nothing transferring to Broadway. The creator did see it in London but frames this as promotion of the upcoming Broadway run; the Broadway production is not on the provided list.
